        repo_id='Systran/faster-whisper-large-v3-turbo',
        cache_dir=hf_cache,
    )
    print('Download complete')
initContainers.name: model-download

args:
set -e
VENV="/root/faster-whisper-server/.venv"
HF_CACHE="/root/.cache/huggingface/hub"

mkdir -p "$HF_CACHE"

DEEPDML_DIR="$HF_CACHE/models--deepdml--faster-whisper-large-v3-turbo-ct2"
if [ -d "$DEEPDML_DIR/snapshots" ]; then
  echo "Model already cached at $DEEPDML_DIR, skipping download"
else
  echo "Downloading deepdml/faster-whisper-large-v3-turbo-ct2 (public CT2 model)..."
  "$VENV/bin/python" -c "
from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download
result = snapshot_download(
    repo_id='deepdml/faster-whisper-large-v3-turbo-ct2',
    cache_dir='$HF_CACHE',
)
print('Downloaded to:', result)
"
fi

# Systran/faster-whisper-large-v3-turbo is gated (401 as of June 2026).
# faster_whisper maps short name 'large-v3-turbo' -> Systran repo.
# Symlink makes the Systran cache path resolve to the deepdml model.
SYSTRAN_DIR="$HF_CACHE/models--Systran--faster-whisper-large-v3-turbo"
if [ ! -e "$SYSTRAN_DIR" ]; then
  ln -s "models--deepdml--faster-whisper-large-v3-turbo-ct2" "$SYSTRAN_DIR"
  echo "Created symlink: $SYSTRAN_DIR -> models--deepdml--faster-whisper-large-v3-turbo-ct2"
else
  echo "Systran dir already present: $SYSTRAN_DIR"
fi

echo "Model cache ready"
initContainers.name: model-download

args:
set -e
VENV="/root/faster-whisper-server/.venv"
HF_CACHE="/root/.cache/huggingface/hub"

mkdir -p "$HF_CACHE"

DEEPDML_DIR="$HF_CACHE/models--deepdml--faster-whisper-large-v3-turbo-ct2"
if [ -d "$DEEPDML_DIR/snapshots" ]; then
  echo "Model already cached, skipping download"
else
  echo "Downloading deepdml/faster-whisper-large-v3-turbo-ct2..."
  "$VENV/bin/python" -c "
from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download
result = snapshot_download(
    repo_id='deepdml/faster-whisper-large-v3-turbo-ct2',
    cache_dir='$HF_CACHE',
)
print('Downloaded to:', result)
"
fi

# Systran/faster-whisper-large-v3-turbo is gated. Symlink so offline
# cache lookup for "large-v3-turbo" resolves to the deepdml model.
SYSTRAN_DIR="$HF_CACHE/models--Systran--faster-whisper-large-v3-turbo"
if [ ! -e "$SYSTRAN_DIR" ]; then
  ln -s "models--deepdml--faster-whisper-large-v3-turbo-ct2" "$SYSTRAN_DIR"
  echo "Created symlink Systran -> deepdml"
else
  echo "Systran symlink already present"
fi

# Write launcher script to PVC so the main container can run it.
# The launcher monkeypatches faster_whisper._MODELS to add "large-v3-turbo"
# (this fedirz image bundles a faster-whisper version that doesn't know turbo).
cat > /root/.cache/huggingface/launch.py << 'PYEOF'
import sys, os
sys.path.insert(0, '/root/faster-whisper-server')

# Patch _MODELS before any model loading so "large-v3-turbo" is accepted.
# faster-whisper maps it to Systran/faster-whisper-large-v3-turbo which is
# symlinked in the HF cache to the public deepdml CT2 model.
import faster_whisper.utils as _fw_utils
if isinstance(_fw_utils._MODELS, frozenset):
    _fw_utils._MODELS = _fw_utils._MODELS | {"large-v3-turbo"}
else:
    _fw_utils._MODELS.add("large-v3-turbo")

import uvicorn
uvicorn.run(
    "faster_whisper_server.main:create_app",
    factory=True,
    host="0.0.0.0",
    port=8000,
)
PYEOF

echo "launch.py written"
echo "Init complete"
initContainers.name: model-download

args:
set -e
VENV="/root/faster-whisper-server/.venv"
HF_CACHE="/root/.cache/huggingface/hub"

mkdir -p "$HF_CACHE"

DEEPDML_DIR="$HF_CACHE/models--deepdml--faster-whisper-large-v3-turbo-ct2"
if [ -d "$DEEPDML_DIR/snapshots" ]; then
  echo "Model already cached, skipping download"
else
  echo "Downloading deepdml/faster-whisper-large-v3-turbo-ct2..."
  "$VENV/bin/python" -c "
from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download
result = snapshot_download(
    repo_id='deepdml/faster-whisper-large-v3-turbo-ct2',
    cache_dir='$HF_CACHE',
)
print('Downloaded to:', result)
"
fi

# Systran/faster-whisper-large-v3-turbo is gated. Symlink so offline
# cache lookup for "large-v3-turbo" resolves to the deepdml model.
SYSTRAN_DIR="$HF_CACHE/models--Systran--faster-whisper-large-v3-turbo"
if [ ! -e "$SYSTRAN_DIR" ]; then
  ln -s "models--deepdml--faster-whisper-large-v3-turbo-ct2" "$SYSTRAN_DIR"
  echo "Created symlink Systran -> deepdml"
else
  echo "Systran symlink already present"
fi

# Write launcher script via base64 to avoid YAML indentation issues.
# Script patches _MODELS to accept "large-v3-turbo" (older faster-whisper
# doesn't know this size; _MODELS is a tuple so we use concatenation).
echo '' | base64 -d > /root/.cache/huggingface/launch.py
echo "launch.py written"
echo "Init complete"
initContainers.name: model-download
